propositions: Compiled state must track plan_review_phase (planning or execution) independently from execution_mode, updated only by winning process_status entries and preserved through snapshots and compaction
Planning manifests emit review-phase: planning; execution manifests emit review-phase: execution followed by priority-floor: 0.80 with exact token grammar and structured validation
Phase compatibility enforcement: planning accepts planning/legacy/execution, execution accepts planning/legacy and execution floor >= 0.80, mismatches return incompatible phase_status

Signing must collect an immutable pre-LLM generation capturing phase/floor/material/relations/revision, retry at most three times on HEAD instability, and commit atomically under lock without partial writes on failure
Re-sign recovery parses v2 sidecar phase fields, refuses incompatible/malformed variants, and uses recorded phase/floor instead of inferring new phase
